test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

statements.

**Statements:**

Some words are short.

Some shorts are long.

All long are tree.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tree are short.

II. Some tree are words.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b072996b92045c9a488dffaeaf6bc70dd5fe9799d90bb77e8e0ec0b5bedef4d4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tree are short. → **Follows** (As, some shorts are long and all long are tree)

II. Some tree are words. → **Not follow** (As, there is no definite relation between tree and words. Hence, false)

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion I follows"**.
